payload.title: Auto-trigger git-native log compaction
payload.body: compactGitNativeLog exists but nothing calls it automatically, so the append-only log grows unbounded. foldLog is O(n) git subprocess calls and runs on every list/next/claim/render, so at thousands of events claims slow down and the projection render risks timing out. Trigger compaction from the projection job past a size threshold, make it single-writer-safe (currently force-deletes the ref locally with no push, which can race), and surface log size in tasks doctor / fleet stats.
